---
name: Revision text integrity
description: Lossless storage and display rules for quote revision text
---
Revision text must be stored and printed in full without shortening or ellipses.

**Why:** The revision register is the durable record of project changes. Truncating an automatically generated change before saving permanently loses part of that record.

**How to apply:** Keep generated old/new values lossless. If an on-screen compact preview is ever necessary, retain the complete stored value, provide an explicit “Show full text” control, and always print and copy the complete text.
